uncited: **Inputs:** A pre-trained 3DGS model (representing the target scene) and a reference style image.
**Outputs:** A stylized 3DGS model with modified colors and features.

The method operates on the standard 3DGS representation: a set of $N$ Gaussians, each defined by position $\mathbf{\mu}$, covariance $\mathbf{\Sigma}$ (or scale/rotation), opacity $\alpha$, and spherical harmonics coefficients for color/view-dependent appearance.
StylizedGS modifies the color/feature attributes during optimization.
**Rendering:** Render the current 3DGS model to obtain color and depth maps for each training view.
*   **Nearest Neighbor Feature Match Loss ($\mathcal{L}_{feat}$):** Measures the discrepancy between the rendered features of the stylized 3DGS and the features of the style image.
**Optimization:** Update the 3DGS parameters (primarily color/feature attributes) to minimize $\mathcal{L}$.
